findings.summary: A completed tool-use response with trailing assistant text could not be converted back into Messages history.

resolution.reason: Permit text to continue the same assistant turn while tools are pending, but do not allow a new user turn or a new assistant turn inside a partially returned tool-result group.

verification.detail: The prior accepted-output/next-input rejection was reproduced. The signed namespace/tool roundtrip now includes trailing assistant text; separate regressions reject interrupted parallel-result groups. All32 package tests pass.

findings.summary: Tool JSON truncated by max_tokens was parsed before the stop reason, incorrectly turning incomplete output into a protocol error.

resolution.reason: Finalize completed-tool arguments only after the real terminal state is known, validating every completed tool before any dispatch event. Explicit max_tokens termination remains incomplete; a partial custom JSON wrapper is not exposed as freeform input.

verification.detail: Function/custom truncation passes in both SSE and JSON modes with no completed tool dispatch. A malformed completed tool still fails before an earlier valid tool can be dispatched. Missing-terminal failures remain covered.

findings.summary: Adapter-owned encrypted Messages reasoning was forwarded to native Responses backends after an in-thread model switch.
applies_to: Messages-to-native Responses transitions through this bridge
aliases: encrypted content could not be verified
Encrypted content could not be decrypted or parsed

resolution.reason: Only native outbound requests omit reasoning carrying both adapter-owned ID and ciphertext markers. Original conversations, visible/tool history and native reasoning are not rewritten; Messages-to-Messages verification remains unchanged.

verification.detail: The new synthetic native-backend regression failed with400 before the fix and passed after it for both GitHub and Windows native routes. It asserts visible/tool/native state retention and original-input immutability; all25 package tests pass.

findings.summary: Historical and current direct App API success plus synthetic bridge tests do not establish this machine's Codex access to both sources.

resolution.reason: The previously blocked target later completed bounded native dual-source acceptance and Opus-specific acceptance. This closes that target's historical gap, not the separate new-machine or all-model validation boundary.

verification.detail: Reviewed preserved same-day results for selected GitHub/Windows SSE and isolated CLI, Opus stream/tool/patch/read checks, and user-operated target UI. This review issued no new requests and does not relabel manual UI as an empty-directory experiment.

findings.summary: The original App relay accepts arbitrary local callers; bridge authentication does not secure its direct port on a multi-user machine.
Messages-only models require explicit protocol conversion with bounded tools, thinking and history support; Sydney, hosted tools and Windows compaction remain unsupported.
applies_to: Unsupported hosted tools or cross-provider history

findings.summary: The supplied project's .venv directory was a stale Python 3.6.8 layout without Scripts/python.exe, while the project requires Python 3.12+.
applies_to: Provided Windows source checkout before runtime preparation

resolution.reason: Preserved the stale directory and original source checkout; prepared a new private tracked-source copy with a valid Python 3.13.5 environment and the pinned mitmproxy dependency.

verification.detail: 55 supplied pytest tests and ruff passed in the new environment. Read-only doctor located Python, mitmdump and Copilot App and confirmed both ports free. No CA trust, relay startup, inference or GUI turn was performed.

findings.summary: A Windows PowerShell5.1 child without the Certificate provider misreported a successfully installed temporary CA as untrusted.
applies_to: Pinned App relay0.2.0 invoking Windows PowerShell from the observed native Windows environment

resolution.reason: Import the child PowerShell's own security module before queries. Apply only to the hash-checked private runtime source, preserve original bytes, and independently remove the exact CA left by the failed start.

verification.detail: The same trusted thumbprint changed from False to True after explicit module import. Exact failed-run CA removal succeeded. Patched runtime passed all55 supplied tests and then started successfully, captured its own-session token and fetched actual model metadata.

findings.summary: This target's execution host rejected bridge configuration/startup preparation before execution; live bridge/Codex acceptance cannot proceed through that path.
applies_to: Observed execution host rejecting the two proposed private bridge-setup commands; exact policy rule unknown
aliases: Windows Copilot 分流器启动被拒

resolution.reason: The operational blocker on the observed target was cleared after the normal interactive permission selection and explicitly authorized host-managed deployment. The exact rule behind the old denied commands is still not established; fresh managed denials must not be bypassed.

verification.detail: Reviewed the exact target-thread on-request/restricted-workspace setting and subsequent bridge readiness/inference records. No claim that the original denied command was replayed or that changing approval policy overrides every enforcement layer.

findings.summary: The observed target reused an existing GitHub installation; a pristine-machine rebuild, full model matrix and logout/reboot recovery remain unverified.
applies_to: Different GitHub gateways or key formats
Full Windows model and lifecycle acceptance

findings.summary: A running relay without keepalive retained an expired token and returned models401; standalone renewal also requires explicit process ownership.

resolution.reason: After authorization, use one normally managed App-based renewal worker, verify a newer token and actual metadata, and independently track/stop standalone workers not registered in launcher pids.json.

verification.detail: Reviewed expired-token/models401 followed by newer-expiry/models200 in preserved target results, and checked the supplied keepalive/launcher implementation. This does not guarantee renewal while locked or after reboot.

findings.summary: An extra request from one UI turn exhausted the temporary validation ledger and caused local429s to appear as model failures.
aliases: exceeded retry limit, last status: 429 Too Many Requests

resolution.reason: Use a separately budgeted test endpoint, account for auxiliary requests, and remove only the test-budget reference when authorized normal use begins. Preserve the ledger; do not reset usage or assume upstream quota failure.

verification.detail: Reviewed the exhausted ledger, two successful requests for one UI turn, later local429s, approved budget extension and successful normal-use readiness with accounting preserved.

findings.summary: The catalog recommendation did not identify the configured probe model, and a user UI model selection changed the persisted default.

resolution.reason: Check actual configuration and target turn/UI model/effort independently of catalog recommendation. Reconcile later user changes before restoring defaults or rolling back.

verification.detail: Reviewed the failed catalog-default assumption and recorded one-line default changes; user-confirmed choices were preserved or restored without replacing unrelated configuration.

findings.summary: A relative-path shell read failed after successful patch creation, while an explicit workdir/absolute-path read passed; the underlying shell-directory cause was not established.
applies_to: Observed Windows Codex synthetic tool verification
